identification: Boosey & Co 'Solbron' Class A silver plated cornet (Light Valve), serial 83214, about 1910s, in original leather fitted case, retailed by Findlay's Proprietary, Launceston & N.W. Tasmania. Photos show worn plating, scuffed case, original lyre/mouthpiece holder.

viewing_check: Check valves move freely and are not seized, look for dents, dings or solder repairs in the bell and tubing, and confirm the mouthpiece and lyre are present. Photograph the serial 83214 and any other stamps, and the Findlay's engraving. Note the case interior and latches.
